questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine development using anthropological evidence

stimulus.body: A national government launches a program to raise incomes and improve health and education, measuring progress through a set of economic and social indicators.

questions.stem: Which statement about development is best supported by the account?

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
questions.learningObjective: examine modernization using anthropological evidence

questions.subject: ANTHROPOLOGY
